goal: Make Linux release binaries portable across non-glibc distributions and systems with older glibcs
Allow bitcoind and CLI tools to run on platforms like Alpine and NixOS without compatibility shims
reviewability: Review is worthwhile now with no known blockers or invalidating changes
agreement: Broad testing confirmation across Alpine, NixOS, and older Linux distributions (0xB10C, dergoegge, jsarenik)
Support because static glibc is more palatable and auditable than switching to musl (theuni)
Unaddressed objection: dynamic NSS resolvers break when loading host libraries, no author reply (luke-jr)
Open question on whether static binaries should drop fortify checks (willcl-ark)

categories.name: build
why: P2 because it enables release binaries to run natively on distributions like Alpine and NixOS
Older Linux installations and container environments no longer require glibc workarounds
